known_fixes_and_hardening.title: CSP origin validation and effective-policy qualification
known_fixes_and_hardening.description: Candidate rejects policy punctuation, wildcards and credentials in configured origins, checks effective enforcing meta/header policies and limits scanner exemptions to the configured connect-src range. Preserve the distinction between artifact policy and actual host enforcement.

known_fixes_and_hardening.title: Known public test release keys excluded from release verification
known_fixes_and_hardening.description: Candidate rejects the listed public test verification keys in identified release builds; the Pages builder explicitly requests production parsing before bundling manifests. This is a source guard; no production key inventory was inspected.

known_fixes_and_hardening.title: Registry read lifecycle and network revision invalidation
known_fixes_and_hardening.description: Candidate aborts obsolete operations after lifecycle/context changes and includes network revision in review authority and lookup checks. This does not reclassify BROWSER-01 onto the assigned older snapshots.

known_fixes_and_hardening.title: Strict merchant-pin JSON and narrow profile composition
known_fixes_and_hardening.description: Candidate rejects ambiguous duplicate pin members through strict JSON parsing and allows the wider build profile only for known full/absent inputs. These are existing changes, not new confirmed production findings.

known_fixes_and_hardening.title: Monotonic expiry floor during local delay
known_fixes_and_hardening.description: Candidate combines finite-clock validation and monotonic elapsed time with the current wall clock for expiry while waiting or skipping the wait. This helper alone does not establish every submit-time expiry check.

known_fixes_and_hardening.title: Shared lean exclusions across artifact gates
known_fixes_and_hardening.description: Candidate shares module-exclusion logic between the bundle scanner and Pages verifier and restricts the allowed embedHost export. Reading a generated-report gate is not evidence that a build passed.

known_fixes_and_hardening.title: Artifact integrity before promotion and attestation before deployment
known_fixes_and_hardening.description: Candidate builder invokes independent exact-file/checksum/source-commit verification before promoting site/evidence. The workflow isolates attestation permissions and requires that job before deploy. Trusted checksum provenance and stable verification inputs remain explicit requirements.

known_fixes_and_hardening.title: Declared origin and expanded navigation smoke scope
known_fixes_and_hardening.description: Candidate compiles its declared origin and passes it to post-deployment smoke. The smoke source visits lean views and a synthetic invoice while recording off-project requests. These scripts were read only; no deployed state was established.

review_boundaries.description: Router fee-recipient availability is immutable: native rejection or token restrictions can stop fee-bearing transfers. Metadata/announcements alone do not establish invoice authenticity, a valid ephemeral curve point or arbitrary token trust. ROOT-A01/ROOT-A02 context remains; no new bypass is claimed.

The relayer signature includes token, owner, destination, fee recipient, amount, fee, deadline and nonce. Authorization consumes the owner nonce before token calls, and execution checks exact deltas. Third-party cryptographic library internals and deployed bytecode were not re-audited.

Tag code derives separate nonextractable AES/HMAC keys, binds version-2 ciphertext to chain/record/lookup coordinates, and stages imports/rotation for guarded snapshot-dependent batch writes. Runtime storage durability, all caller lifecycles and WebCrypto implementation behavior were not executed or requalified here.

Both assigned RegistryView versions mount WalletAttempts without a wallet prop. That call shape alone is insufficient for BROWSER-01: the canonical register confines it to the separate #300 component contract. This pass did not reread that branch or expand the finding to main/candidate.
